messages:
Priya S: Quick heads-up — ProtonGrid reached out about a joint perf run focused on thermal throttling and perf/W across our quantization profiles. They want a two-week sweep and a short public blog blurb afterwards. Can we scope?
Miguel L: +1, ProtonGrid eng here. We can provide rack time and per-board power telemetry. Need your benchmark matrix and target sequences.
Tom K: I can assemble workloads (chat, completion, embeddings) and target seq lengths 128/512/2048. Want to include prefix cache hot vs cold?
Priya S: Yes include prefix hot/cold. Also want a kernel param sweep: block_size, fused_attention flags, and mixed-precision toggles. Aim: perf/W and 95th latency.
Miguel L: Good. We can expose on-board thermals and power samples at 1s. Also can throttle fan profiles to reproduce thermal headroom.
Tom K: Drafted a minimal run command — Miguel can you validate?
Tom K: ```bash
run_bench --model redwood-v2-slim --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant int8 --kernel-opts "block=128,fused=1" --sensors /dev/power0
```
Miguel L: Command looks fine. FYI on ProtonGrid we need `--sensors /sys/proton/power_samples` path. Also would prefer `--run-id` tagged with partner name.
Priya S: Good catch. Miguel, can you provision 3 boards for the dry run next Tue and 6 boards for the full sweep the following week?
Miguel L: Yep, dry run Tue 09:00 PT. I'll post machine IDs and SSH access by EOD today.
Ewa P: @Priya S FYI benchbot queued the dry-run tests when Miguel posts the IDs. I'll post run links and aggregated CSV after each job finishes. :robot_face:
BenchBot: Scheduled job 38291 (dry-run) for 1767013200, will post results to /shared/protongrid/38291.
Tom K: For aggregations, let's collect: tokens/sec, avg power (W), perf/W (tokens/sec / W), p95 latency, peak die temp. Can we add kernel param columns in the CSV?
Miguel L: Yes, we'll inject kernel metadata in the run manifest. Also we can capture fan RPM and GPU voltage.
Priya S: Great. Who's owning dashboard? I can spin a short looker panel but prefer infra to own long-term.
Tom K: I'll do a quick Grafana panel (15m). Link after dry run. For public blog we'll need PR approval and legal review; assign content owners?
Priya S: I'll own partner comms + blog draft. Tom — you own technical appendix. Miguel, ProtonGrid to provide quotes and logos. Legal: @LegalTeam (we'll ping separately).
Miguel L: Sounds good. One ask from our side — can you include at least one quantized variant that keeps output parity within 1% of baseline? Helps our marketplace listing.
Tom K: We'll add INT8 + QAT tuned run. May take longer per-config but ok.
Ewa P: Reminder: include seed, model git hash, runtime version, and kernel commit in every run manifest. BenchBot will reject runs missing those fields.
Priya S: Noted. I'll create the run matrix doc and invite everyone. Link: https://redwood-internal/protongrid/bench-matrix — add comments.
Miguel L: Added SSH keys and board IDs at https://protongrid-share/boards — Miguel posted 3 IDs for dry run.
BenchBot: Dry-run job 38291 started 1767013200. Streams: https://benchstream/redwood/38291
Tom K: I'll monitor. If dry run looks good we'll open the full sweep and invite marketing for announcement timing.
Priya S: Plan: dry-run Tue, full sweep Wed-Fri next week, internal results Wed afternoon, draft blog ready Fri AM. Marketing sync Thu.
Miguel L: Acknowledged. Anything else?
Tom K: One last note — we'll pin a short failure recovery: fallback to smaller batch and lower seq if OOM/thermal cutoffs. Add to run manifest as `fallback_policy`.
Priya S: Perfect. Thanks all — will send calendar invites and create the run matrix doc now. :thumbsup:
